title: Lock, mechanical
summary: A mechanical lock that requires a physical key. Without one of the normal ways of accessing the lock, a creature proficient with locksmith’s tools can pick this lock with a successful DC 15 Dexterity check. Better…
markdown: A mechanical lock that requires a physical key. Without one of the normal ways of accessing the lock, a creature proficient with locksmith’s tools can pick this lock with a successful DC 15 Dexterity check. Better locks are available at higher prices.
